scraped.title: Health Management Information System
scraped.subtitle: Development of a Health Management Information System
scraped.clientName: Delegation of the European Union to Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan
scraped.description: The project aimed to modernize Tajikistan's healthcare system by strengthening the Health Information System (HIS) to generate reliable data. Working with key institutions like the State Committee for Statistics (SCS) and the Republican Centre for Medical Statistics and…
body: The project aimed to modernize Tajikistan's healthcare system by strengthening the Health Information System (HIS) to generate reliable data. Working with key institutions like the State Committee for Statistics (SCS) and the Republican Centre for Medical Statistics and Information (RCMSI), the project focused on three key components.

ICON-INSTITUT developed a tailored HIS Strategy Roadmap and improved coordination between institutions, designing a strategy and implementation plan for the Health Management Information System (HMIS) and the civil registration system. Second, the HMIS was modernized, with core health indicators finalized, forms computerized, and data quality guidelines established to improve health data reporting and dissemination. Third, the civil registration system was updated, including a review of forms, management systems, and technical specifications for software procurement. This project significantly enhanced Tajikistan's capacity to manage and use health data effectively.
